title: Handbook slice
description: Body of a `report` artifact: the engine's half of the handbook slice one step of a board task's run is given (design/handbook.md#the-per-worker-slice, ADR-0072), as its brief points at it (role `context`). The parts of layers 1 to 4 that bear on the step's role, task class, risk tier, and touched paths, rendered by the engine from the layers' declared homes, never by a model; the Worker source renders the other half (the gate view, the lessons). The brief's `handbook` (brief@1.6) records the versions and sizes.

parts.description: The ids of the parts the text carries, in order.
